channel.title: Luis Arévalo
channel.description: Aerospace engineer in Madrid. I write about what I learn using AI to work better.

item.title: One AI envoy for every team
item.description: What slows work down most isn't technology but waiting on other teams. Pablo Fernández proposes giving every team an AI agent that keeps track of its commitments. Here's my take.

item.title: Being busy is no longer a badge of honour
item.description: Armand Ruiz argues that busy people will be the biggest losers of the AI era. I agree, and this is what I think will happen in the coming months.
